relations.description: The NORMAL-SERVICE substate is part of the 5GMM-REGISTERED state.
The UE enters the NORMAL-SERVICE substate when the cell is in an allowed area for 3GPP access.
The UE enters the NORMAL-SERVICE substate when wireline access service area restrictions are not enforced.
